ops.oldText: Contractor reserves the right to change rates with 30 days notice to Company.
ops.newText: Contractor may change rates no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, upon at least thirty (30) days prior written notice to Company, and any such increase shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in CPI over the preceding twelve (12) months and three percent (3%). No rate change shall apply to any Statement of Work then outstanding without Company's prior written consent.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs on an evergreen term with a 15-day exit, which works for us, but Contractor can currently raise rates at will on 30 days' notice, including mid-Statement of Work. We have limited rate changes to once a year, capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% (we can live with 5% as a fallback), and excluded work already under an outstanding Statement of Work.
input.summary: Cap Contractor rate increases at lesser of CPI and 3%, once per year, not applicable to outstanding SOWs.
